title: Foggy memories
content: The past 2 nights I have had very intense dreams . To the point if I wake up in the middle of the night and go back to bed I go right back to the same place/ situation I did right before I woke up. I just can’t remember details of what went on . I know so much happened the past 2 nights. I can feel it. But it’s like something is now blocking my memories completely. Usually even if I couldn’t remember the full dream I would remember details of places and how things look, now it’s almost blurry in my mind of what happened and I can’t remember. Has anyone else experienced this the past few nights ? I either remember everything, bits and pieces or there’s times like this when my memory is just blurred and jogged .
